frs.title: Load and validate an FR catalogue from JSON
frs.description: Given a path to a v3 catalogue JSON file, the system reads it, validates against the schema, snapshots it immutably into the DB, and makes its FRs available for state computation.

tests.description: Loader accepts valid v3 catalogues and rejects malformed ones.

frs.title: Compute FR state from test results
frs.description: After tests run, the system computes a state per FR (untested | pending | passed | failed | waived | blocked) using the precedence ladder.

tests.description: 8-state precedence ladder exercised across all transitions.

frs.title: Match evidence records to test specs
frs.description: The system matches collected evidence (scanner findings, test case results) against the tests declared on each FR, producing pass/fail per test.

tests.description: Matcher handles each spec type correctly.

frs.title: Execute configured scanners against a codebase
frs.description: When a scan is requested, the system spawns each configured scanner as a sibling container via the host docker socket, captures stdout/stderr, parses findings, and stores raw artifacts + normalized findings in SQLite.

tests.description: Per-scanner parsers correctly normalize SARIF/JSON output.

frs.title: Persist scanner findings and raw artifacts in SQLite
frs.description: All scanner output (normalized findings, raw gzip-compressed artifacts) is stored durably in SQLite. Project repo is never written to.

frs.title: Discover and run project test suites
frs.description: The system discovers tests (via assurance-tests.json or convention) and runs each in a sibling container, parsing JUnit XML output into per-testcase results.

frs.title: Expose findings, scans, FRs, compliance, and trends via REST
frs.description: REST API under /api/* serves the frontend and external scripts.

frs.title: Expose tools via MCP Streamable HTTP
frs.description: The system serves an MCP endpoint at /mcp exposing 11 tools for agents (Claude Code, Cursor) to drive scans, fetch findings, manage waivers, and request workflows.

frs.title: Serve a SvelteKit UI for browsing scans, FRs, and compliance
frs.description: Built SvelteKit app served at /, with pages for scan list, scan detail, FR list, FR detail, compliance matrix, and trends.

frs.title: Stream live scan events via Server-Sent Events
frs.description: GET /api/scans/{run_id}/stream emits scan_started, scanner_started, scanner_completed, scan_completed events with Last-Event-ID resume support.

frs.title: Serve templated agent prompts via MCP
frs.description: list_workflows and get_workflow MCP tools expose ready-made agent prompts so users don't paste prompts.

frs.title: Aggregate FR states by compliance framework
frs.description: GET /api/compliance and /api/compliance/{framework} return traffic-light matrices per compliance framework, with each row's state derived from the worst state of FRs satisfying it.

frs.title: Create, list, and revoke FR waivers
frs.description: Standing waivers override an FR's state to 'waived' on subsequent scans. Exposed via REST and the add_waiver/revoke_waiver MCP tools.

frs.title: Project source code is free of HIGH-severity known security issues
frs.description: Semgrep and gitleaks scan the source tree. Findings at HIGH or CRITICAL severity fail this FR.

tests.description: Semgrep must produce no HIGH or CRITICAL findings.
Gitleaks must produce no HIGH or CRITICAL findings.

frs.title: Project Dockerfiles follow container security best practices
frs.description: trivy-config scans all Dockerfiles. No DS-* (Dockerfile Security) findings.

tests.description: Trivy config must produce no DS-* findings.
